# Hook Street Services

> Independent real-estate underwriting and practical operating help for
> owner-run businesses. One operator — Sam Treitel — a few doors in: an honest,
> in-writing read on what you actually have and should do, then help acting on
> it. Fixed scope, flat fee, never a cut. An imprint of Hook Street Capital LLC.

Sam Treitel is an independent underwriter and operator: 15+ years underwriting,
including multi-property acquisition packages exceeding $50 million in combined
purchase price, across New York, Texas, Florida, Mississippi, and Georgia.
Hook Street also operates its own hospitality business (two 8-bedroom villas
near Disney at sommersethillsvillas.com) on the same systems it advises.
Every engagement is handled by Sam directly and delivered in writing.
The full site is mirrored in Hebrew at /he/.

## Services

- The Deal Snapshot (/deal-snapshot): an independent read on a real-estate deal
  before you sign. $2,500 flat, 24-hour turnaround: one-page verdict, the real
  waterfall re-underwritten, sensitivity table, the risks the package glosses,
  and a 30-minute walkthrough call.
- The Bottleneck Review (/bottleneck): the front door. A 90-minute review of an
  owner-run business plus a written read — the 1-3 bottlenecks costing time,
  money, or control, and a 30-day fix plan. $1,000 flat; the review stands on
  its own, and any further engagement is scoped and quoted separately.
- Operating Systems (/systems): fixed-scope sprints (Operating Map, Revenue
  Loop) and "Operate," a part-time chief-of-staff monthly retainer that keeps
  the operating rhythm running.
- The AI Talk (/ai-call): a 30-minute talk on your AI question, in plain
  English, with a short written brief after. $350 founding rate for the first
  five talks, then $500.
- Websites (/websites): see your site drafted — usually the same day — before
  you spend a dollar. A private draft link that lives for a week, then live on
  your own domain; optional ongoing operation after launch. English and Hebrew.
- Private Capital Review (limited pilot, by invitation): a source-backed owner
  brief on private holdings after you invest.
- Capital Readiness & Receivables Review (/capital): an independent read on
  receivables, cash flow, and financing readiness before taking on capital.
  Hook Street is not a lender.
